RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel can reflect in-group bias or broader diversity issues in senior banking, but it does not constitute proof of discrimination. For a "head of" position, banks frequently value broad regulatory affairs and governance experience above pure quantitative depth, offering a legitimate non-discriminatory rationale.

Whether to raise it depends on your objectives. Do not mention gender if you wish to preserve the relationship or receive useful feedback, as unsubstantiated claims will burn bridges. If you are contemplating formal legal action, consult an employment attorney before acting. For now, simply send a neutral follow-up requesting your feedback.
